utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon. The case Miroslav Deronjic -- the Prosecutor against Miroslav Deronjic, case reference IT-02-61-A. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: The appearances, please, for the accused.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Slobodan Zecevic. I am counsel for Mr. Deronjic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. Mr. Deronjic, can you understand me? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Yes, I can understand you completely, Your Excellency. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: The appearances for the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCKEON
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Mark McKeon, acting senior appeals counsel for the Prosecution. With me at counsel table is appeal counsel Barbara Goy as well as our case manager Lourdes Galicia. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. I know counsel for the appellant contacted the Court to know if he had to be prepared for the Status Conference. The Status Conference is for you and your client to raise issues you might deem necessary for the Judges to know. So the Blank page inserted to ensure the pagination between the English and French transcripts correspond floor is yours.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: We understand, Your Honour. We just wanted to make sure that we'd be of assistance to the Trial Chamber, or to you, Your Honour, as a Pre-Appeal Judge, if there is anything on the agenda which the Trial Chamber or you yourself wanted to raise, any issues. We, as the Defence and our client, we don't have any issues whatsoever. Thank you very much. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. The Prosecution, do you want to raise any issue?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCKEON
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. There's nothing that we want to raise today. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. Then it will be a very short Status Conference. I understand that the Prosecution has to respond to the brief of appeal, and -- yes?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCKEON
utterances.text: Nothing, Your Honour. I was just going to respond that we are preparing our response to that. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: And I understand that counsel for the appellant is planning to make some presentation in the near future.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: So we will wait for these documents and then we'll set a date for the hearing. And thank you to you all; the conference is adjourned.
